opening.argument: The presentation promotes Mirror Trading International as an investment route for weekly income, stating that “Each member gets forty percent of the trading profits once a week” while describing trading performed on members’ behalf. It directs viewers to open and fund a broker account through a special registration link, with a stated $200 minimum deposit, recruitment-based earning levels, and a 10% Bitcoin-deposit referral bonus. The structure requires that “a member must sponsor one person on his left and another on his right,” and ties additional income to weaker-leg volume and total funds under management. Although it asserts broker affiliation, fund safety, and daily reporting, it shows no actual trades, payments, or realized earnings. The arrangement therefore presents pooled or managed trading returns through recruitment and deposits, rather than demonstrated profits.

citations.quote: Have you been looking for where to invest your money and earn income weekly?
Each member gets forty percent of the trading profits once a week
a member must sponsor one person on his left and another on his right
20% of the trading profit for the week will be distributed proportionately based on the volume amount a member has on his weaker leg and the total funds under management
